c74object.name: evi_limiterfast
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A fast no-lookahead limiter with anti-aliased nonlinear clipping
c74object.description:
evi_limiterfast is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_limiterfast.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr, evi_clip.genexpr, evi_biquads.genexpr, evi_biquads_filters.genexpr
evi_limiterfast is also available in MSP as: evi.limiterfast~.
A basic stereo limiter. Being a no-lookahead limiter, the 'crunch' can kick in quite easily. evi.limiterfast~ features an anti-aliased antiderivative hard clipping function to deal with this. Other than that it features fixed hard attack, a settable soft knee, variable smoothing, release time set in ms. The AGC envelope is available at the far right outlet.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input Left. Left audio to be limited.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input Right. Right audio to be limited.

attribute.name: ingain
attribute.description: Artificially engage the limiter by increasing @ingain. This is the reverse of a 'threshold'. Smoothed internally.

attribute.name: knee
attribute.description: Nearer 0, the knee is hard, nearer 1 the knee is soft.

attribute.name: release
attribute.description: The release time of the envelope detector. The object is tuned to work well with short times.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing factor of the envelope response. 0 = not smooth at all, 1 = aggressively smoothed.
